ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: CLASSICAL MUSIC IN AMERICAN CULTURE AND SOCIETY - An exploration of how Americans have adapted, imported, and reshaped the genres and styles of European art music as a means of uniquely New-World artistic expression. Topics will include the music of Moravian communities, American Romanticists, the establishing of orchestras and opera companies in the United States, touring virtuosi and the American audience for art music, the contribution of European emigrants and refugees to the American scene, the international dissemination of American music.
